imagem.prompt: Create one premium architectural visualization board with TWO equal side-by-side photorealistic panels, landscape 16:9 overall, no headings or decorative frame. Use the provided two images as strict architectural and furniture layout references: left panel is the EXTERIOR of the exact single-story rectangular COE Holambra Agroindustrial Cooperative building; right panel is the INTERIOR of the SAME building. Preserve geometric proportions, bay positions, white flat roof with the existing solar panels, glass front, deep NAVY BLUE fascia #003A70 with thin RED #EF3340 accent, Holambra cooperative red windmill and Holambra lettering at front, covered access on right, parking strip and totem. Do not use a municipal crest or city government branding. Preserve the right interior view's frontal 4x2 videowall with eight panels, six double-operator white desks and a central coordination table, oak slat accent wall on deep navy, pale oak floor, dark ergonomic chairs, dual monitors, telephone and radio equipment. Upgrade ONLY material realism, plausible glass reflections, premium finishes, detailed vegetation/landscape, realistic cars and chairs, ambient occlusion and soft architectural lighting. Cinematic late-afternoon outside, balanced warm linear ceiling lighting inside; highly legible functional architectural composition, realistic PBR finishes, refined sophisticated executive presentation, visually plausible building. No humans. Screen graphics show illustrative charts, not claims of live data. No new wings, no futuristic towers, no monumental city skyline, no extra logos. The design should remain recognizably the supplied actual interactive model, now in photorealistic architectural render quality.
